title: Show HN: Mcptoon – Token-efficient MCP CLI client
summary: Mcptoon is a lightweight, token-efficient CLI client for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), designed to help developers interact with MCP servers while minimizing token consumption and API costs. It provides a streamlined command-line interface for managing AI tool integrations.
problem_solved: Reduces token usage and associated costs when interacting with MCP-enabled AI tools and services through a lightweight CLI client.
why_valuable: Offers significant cost savings for developers and teams running frequent MCP-based AI workflows by optimizing token efficiency without sacrificing functionality.
